rules.content:
title: Voice Biometric Confidence Score Anomaly for Known Caller
status: experimental
description: Detects when a voice biometric verification score for a previously enrolled caller falls below an acceptable confidence threshold, which may indicate a deepfake or voice-clone attempt impersonating a 
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: voice_authentication
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "voice_biometric_verify"
        enrollment_status: "enrolled"
    filter_low_score:
        voice_confidence_score|lt: 70
    filter_historical_high:
        historical_avg_score|gte: 85
    condition: selection and filter_low_score and filter_historical_high
level: high
rules.title: DL-0050: Voice Biometric Confidence Score Anomaly for Known Caller (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Audio Compression Artifacts Indicative of AI-Generated Speech
status: experimental
description: Detects audio streams exhibiting compression artifacts, spectral anomalies, or frequency-band irregularities characteristic of AI-generated or text-to-speech synthesis engines. These include unnatural
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: voice_authentication
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "voice_stream_analysis"
    filter_artifacts:
        spectral_flatness_score|gt: 0.85
        breath_sound_detected: false
        pitch_variance|lt: 2.5
    filter_codec:
        codec_reencoding_detected: true
    condition: selection and (filter_artifacts or filter_codec)
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0052: Audio Compression Artifacts Indicative of AI-Generated Speech (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Deepfake Anomalies in Video KYC Session
status: experimental
description: Detects anomalies during video KYC (Know Your Customer) sessions that may indicate the use of deepfake technology. Indicators include irregular frame rates suggesting real-time face-swapping, inconsis
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: video_kyc
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "video_kyc_session"
        session_status: "in_progress"
    filter_frame_anomaly:
        frame_rate_variance|gt: 8.0
    filter_lipsync:
        lip_sync_offset_ms|gt: 150
    filter_blink:
        blink_rate_per_minute|lt: 3
    filter_lighting:
        face_background_lighting_delta|gt: 40
    condition: selection and (filter_frame_anomaly or filter_lipsync or filter_blink or filter_lighting)
level: high
rules.title: DL-0053: Deepfake Anomalies in Video KYC Session (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: AI-Generated Document Detection in Verification
status: experimental
description: Detects indicators of AI-generated or synthetically created identity documents submitted during verification workflows. Flags include metadata anomalies (missing EXIF data, uniform noise patterns), fo
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: document_verification
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "document_verification_scan"
        document_type|contains:
            - "drivers_license"
            - "passport"
            - "national_id"
            - "utility_bill"
    filter_metadata:
        exif_data_present: false
        creation_tool_detected|contains:
            - "stable-diffusion"
            - "midjourney"
            - "dall-e"
            - "photoshop-generative"
    filter_visual:
        gan_artifact_score|gt: 0.7
        microprint_validation: "failed"
    filter_font:
        font_consistency_score|lt: 0.5
    condition: selection and (filter_metadata or filter_visual or filter_font)
level: high
rules.title: DL-0054: AI-Generated Document Detection in Verification (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Iterative Deepfake Tuning Detection")`
`comment("Detects repeated liveness failures followed by success from same device")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:document_verification
  event_type="LIVENESS_CHECK"
| sort 0 device_fingerprint, liveness_timestamp
| eventstats
    count(if(liveness_result="fail", 1, NULL)) as failure_count,
    count(if(liveness_result="pass", 1, NULL)) as success_count,
    min(liveness_timestamp) as first_attempt,
    max(liveness_timestamp) as last_attempt
    by device_fingerprint
| where (last_attempt - first_attempt) <= 86400
    AND failure_count >= 3 AND success_count >= 1
| streamstats current=t window=0 values(liveness_score) as score_history
    by device_fingerprint
| dedup device_fingerprint
| table device_fingerprint, failure_count, success_count,
        score_history, first_attempt, last_attempt
| sort - failure_count
rules.title: DL-0159: Facial Liveness Failure Pattern — Iterative Deepfake Tuning (SPLUNK)
